summary.text: Megan Phillips is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A licensed clinical psychologist and Overland Park resident, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running to protect public education, expand mental health services and support families.

paragraphs.text: Megan Phillips earned a bachelor's degree from Lewis & Clark College in 2007 and a doctorate in clinical psychology from Pacific University in 2012.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a clinical psychologist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a licensed clinical psychologist and behavioral health executive who works within the Kansas state hospital system.
Phillips said in the survey that mental health is her deepest passion and that she wants to protect public schools and special education funding.
She also said she would advocate eliminating anonymous legislation and recording all legislative votes.
